title.narrative: Training - Global Procurement Initiative: Life-Cycle Cost Analysis Curriculum Platform Maintenance and Supply Training, through Supply Chain Vision, Inc.

description.narrative: This training contract funds a sole-source contract for Supply Chain Vision, Inc. to continue to host and maintain the Life Cycle Cost Analysis (LCCA) web-based course developed under a previous contract. The Contractor will be responsible for hosting and maintaining the online course and applying necessary changes to the curriculum for a period of one year plus four option years, if exercised. The LCCA web-based course is utilized to train procurement practitioners in value-based procurement methods under the Global Procurement Initiative (GPI): Understanding Best Value. This requests authorization to proceed with the optional task for supplemental live trainings under the Life-Cycle Cost Analysis Curriculum Platform Maintenance and Supplemental Training Contract and provides two 60-minute webinars to two current partner countries under the Global Procurement Initiative (GPI): Understanding Best Value. The requested authorization allows Supply Chain Visions, Inc., the Contractor currently providing services under this Contract, to develop and deliver the two 60-minute webinars to two current GPI partner countries.
